findings.consumer_failure: inspect_publication checks each source author_kind against only (OPERATOR, AI). A valid IMPORT-authored, separately operator-confirmed publication is listed by published_page but its exact detail raises CATALOG_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE; route detail maps this to HTTP503 and UI shows unavailable. The HTTP consequence is traced from routes.py:49-53, not a separate live-DB observation.
findings.observed: Nine same-reader SOURCE cases: OPERATOR and AI accepted for v1/v2/v3 (six positive controls); IMPORT accepted by actual capture request validation, check_evaluations and exact _publication_payload projection, listed by current-head reader, then refused by detail for all three versions (three mismatches). Guarded compiler/evaluator/material calls attempted zero times. Positive controls additionally retain exact detail after head removal and refuse wrong digest.
findings.evidence_limit: Synthetic immutable driver rows plus actual non-effectful producer functions, not a genuine PostgreSQL capture/freeze/qualification/confirmation/Publish. Source code localizes the concrete incompatible whitelist independently of that later QA.
findings.minimal_fix: Include IMPORT in the source provenance allowlist; retain OPERATOR-only confirmation authority. Add v1/v2/v3 IMPORT controls through inspect_publication, keeping unknown author kinds denied. No producer, BEHAVIOR_FILES, migration, editor or model/runtime authority change is necessary.

Independent complementary safety reviewer owns detailed authorization/concurrency/errors/bounds/UI checks. Existing affected SOURCE tests include auth/input negatives, but they are not a substitute for that review.

NOT_VERIFIED external dependency/material metadata and NOT_AVAILABLE runtime are correct conservative boundaries for this feature, not missing live readiness enforcement disguised as a defect.

No product edits/commits, dependency installs, network calls, model/provider/target/native calls, DB/container/server/browser operations, protected document reads or personal/global/r1/P0 profile operations occurred.
All writes are reviewer-owned scratch files under review-norm; Python imports/tests used -I -B and disabled pytest cacheprovider; no node_modules or main cache writes were requested.
Reticle NOT_RUN_SOURCE_ONLY; no admitted instrumented UI runtime in this task. Chisel BLOCKED_NO_GO; neither tool is credited as a reviewer.
